description: Known, intended differences of the Claude Code adapter (reference) that any candidate may legitimately not share. Included by cc-vs-*.json.

allow.reason: These CC hooks are async in claude/hooks/hooks.json, so the CC adapter does not offer them as gates (spec A.1, A.2). A candidate that can gate them is not a regression.
CC hooks expose no reasoning text, so the adapter pins reasoning_delta=false (spec A.2).
In-process producers have no host hook timeout and declare max_gate_timeout_ms instead (spec 3.3, 9.2).
